Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Standridge
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 446 as introduced could increase the obligations of emergency communication districts by an undetermined amount dependent upon any additional costs incurred for the retention of 911 telephone calls for two years after the call.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 446 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of emergency communication districts by an undetermined amount dependent upon any additional costs incurred for the retention of 911 telephone calls for two years after the call.
